en: Black‑and‑white view of a European city square with a richly decorated octagonal fountain in the foreground. The fountain has a tall, ornate column topped by a standing armed figure and surrounded by small putti figures. The basin is stone and filled with water, with an inscription plaque on its side. Around the square are multi‑story historicist façades covered with large painted advertisements and shop signs in German, including a tobacco and cigars shop and other merchants. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing walk past, including a man with a bicycle and uniformed men, suggesting a bustling urban setting.
